items.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001
items.q: but when we went in his office, you know, he said “you know, you guys got a nice little act

ctx.x: Whew. Was I nervous. When we got off the train, we rode the train here, we got off at Park Avenue and 125th Street. And when we came down those steps I was scared. I never had seen that many people. It was in July. I had never seen that many people on the street before in my life. It was like wooh, I wanted to go right back up those steps man. I was very, very funny to see. And I asked somebody, was it a parade? Because I’d never seen that many people on the street at one time like that. And that was the…
